data.body: rebar-debug Phase 1 residual-defect proof (2026-07-28): three independent code-trace, historical, and empirical lenses converged. Manual /rerun reconstructs the Gerrit event with REST ChangeInfo.id (`rebar~986`), while the live webhook supplied canonical Change-Id (`I969fce55bf212e539f67009ff42447fb234068df`). `_extract` preserves either raw string; `emit_code_review_artifact` uses it in the fingerprint and exact title key. A sequential local real-store experiment with the same decision/diff/revision reused an artifact for the identical raw id but created a second for the alternate id (count 1→2); repeating the alternate id reused the second. This rules out lookup failure, store visibility, revision drift, concurrency, and tracker divergence as causes of the duplicate. History shows the mismatch entered with rerun commit 514ffa054 and exact-title artifact identity 10837ca88; no fix exists on any ref. DEFECT authority: this ticket requires exactly one idempotent revision-scoped artifact. Phase 2 is unlocked. Existing artifacts 8172-4554-a9fc-47da (canonical I… title, incomplete/orphaned) and a4b7-f176-50af-49aa (compact rebar~986 title, linked v2 recovery artifact) require an explicit data-reconciliation decision after code repair.
